tagline: Two snakes on one grid. Send a friend the link.
description:
Send the Invite in the bar above the game. A friend opens the link and drops onto the same board as you — two snakes, one apple, last one still moving wins.

On your own it is the classic: eat, grow, don't hit the wall. Arrows or WASD on a computer; swipe or the pad on a phone. Your best length is saved.

An unofficial port of JavaScript Snake by patorjk.
